title: Successor encoding of a Boolean list
statement: For a Boolean list $D$, let $sK(D)$ be the binary addition of the pair encoding of the raw representation of $D$ and the one-bit list $[1]$.
caveat: The meanings of the raw representation, pair encoding, and binary addition are not supplied.
